audit.whatIsWrong: Content layer repeatedly fabricates 'Ultra Mush' as Milio's ability name and mislabels slots: Warm Hugs (her shield) is tagged (Q) or (W) instead of (E), Cozy Campfire (her heal zone) is tagged (E) instead of (W), and her ultimate is called 'Ultra Mush' instead of Breath of Life.
audit.why: Riot's kit: Q=Ultra Mega Fire Kick, W=Cozy Campfire (heal zone), E=Warm Hugs (shield, 2 charges), R=Breath of Life (cleanse+heal). None of the fabricated/mislabeled names match.
audit.corrected: Renamed every occurrence in whys[4], spikes[0-1].text, early, wants.foe[1-2] to the real ability and slot.

audit.whatIsWrong: All 7 phases[N].side rows say 'Skill' while win[0..6] all already say 'Milio' — the level chart contradicts itself on every row.
audit.why: whys[0..6] all describe Milio winning each stage (poke/heal at L1, shield/heal negating trades, R cleanse countering the L6 all-in, shield/heal scaling faster on first item, R+heals+shields neutering single-target picks late) — win[] is correct, the full-layer side/why text is stale.
audit.corrected: Flipped phases[0..6].side to Milio and rewrote each .why to state the specific reason, grounded in the real kit.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Breath of Life as matchup-defining but gives no cooldown number.
audit.why: Breath of Life is 160/145/130s by rank — a real number the reader can count against.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns rewritten with the actual cooldown range plus Alistar's own Trample cooldown.

edits.before: Her L6 Ultra Mush cleanse hard-counters your R dive, so she wins the spike.
edits.after: Her L6 Breath of Life cleanse hard-counters your R dive, so she wins the spike.

edits.before: You get W-Q at 2 and can flash-combo or W into a Milio who steps up, but if you whiff she Ultra Mush-shields (W) her ADC and Cozy Campfire (E) heals the trade back, so only commit when your Q lands as a guaranteed knockup.
edits.after: You get W-Q at 2 and can flash-combo or W into a Milio who steps up, but if you whiff she shields (Warm Hugs, E) her ADC and Cozy Campfire (W) heals the trade back, so only commit when your Q lands as a guaranteed knockup.

edits.before: Your Unbreakable Will (R) lets you dive through her peel and eat CC, but Milio's ult cleanses your knockups and the slow off Warm Hugs (Q), so time your all-in when her ult and E shield are on cooldown, not before.
edits.after: Your Unbreakable Will (R) lets you dive through her peel and eat CC, but Breath of Life cleanses your knockups and the slow off Ultra Mega Fire Kick (Q), so time your all-in when her R and E shield are on cooldown, not before.

edits.before: Milio can poke you with Ultra Mush (Q) auto-empowers and heal any return damage with E, so you rarely win a straight L1-2 trade; use your bulk to soak and look for a clean W-Q flash rather than a poke war.
edits.after: Milio can poke you with Ultra Mega Fire Kick (Q) auto-empowers and heal any return damage with Cozy Campfire (W), so you rarely win a straight L1-2 trade; use your bulk to soak and look for a clean W-Q flash rather than a poke war.
